_comment: Source of truth for every measured quantity the power forecaster uses. Quantities are keyed by the power characterization firmware's step names and codes (a3em-firmware/tests/peripherals/test_power.c); tools/power/power_ingest.py appends measurements, and nothing else should edit them by hand. See README.md.

units.uA: mean current at the battery terminal, in microamps
units.uC: charge per event at the battery terminal, in microcoulombs, in excess of the baseline state
units.mV: supply voltage at the battery terminal, in millivolts

conditions.supply: PPK2 source meter at 3.6 V unless the quantity depends on a battery, which is measured on that cell in ampere-meter mode

quantities.description: Deep sleep with only what a deployment always has configured: RTC on the crystal, HFRC trim (HFADJ) enabled, magnet sensor and IMU configured and asleep, VHF switch driven off, SD card unpowered, shared SRAM retained.
quantities.forecastRole: The floor every other state is an increment over.

prior.source: Web/reference/A3EM Deployment Planner.xlsx Calculations!E27 (MCU idle, marked '<- Measure')
prior.note: A placeholder; an Apollo4 in deep sleep is expected to sit far below this.

quantities.description: The floor with the HFRC trim disabled.
quantities.forecastRole: Shows whether HFADJ costs anything in deep sleep; the deployment firmware always enables it.

quantities.description: The floor with shared SRAM held fully active rather than retained, as it is while audio DMA runs.
quantities.forecastRole: Increment paid for every second the microphone is capturing, already inside the capture states; isolated here to explain them.

quantities.description: The floor plus a free-running timer on the 32 kHz crystal, no interrupt.
quantities.forecastRole: Baseline for EVT_WAKE; also the cost of any XT-clocked timer left running.

quantities.description: The floor plus a free-running timer on HFRC/16, no interrupt.
quantities.forecastRole: Whether an HFRC-clocked timer keeps the high-frequency oscillator alive in deep sleep. The magnet sensor's active sampling timer is HFRC-clocked.

quantities.description: The floor with the watchdog running, as it always is in a deployment.
quantities.forecastRole: Always-on increment.

quantities.description: The floor plus a 1 Hz crystal-timer wake that does nothing, with the battery monitor initialized.
quantities.forecastRole: Baseline for the 1 Hz core events.

quantities.description: The floor with the magnet sensor sampling every 90 ms, as it does whenever magnetic deactivation is possible.
quantities.forecastRole: Always-on increment during recording phases that allow magnetic deactivation.

prior.source: Web/reference/A3EM Deployment Planner.xlsx MagPower!E2:E5 and Calculations!E29:E30, at 1.8 V
prior.note: Sensor-only duty-cycle model; excludes the HFRC timer that drives it.

quantities.description: The floor with the tracker's I2C slave initialized. The deployment firmware initializes it even when no GPS board is attached.
quantities.forecastRole: Always-on increment; if large, a case for initializing it only when GPS is configured.

quantities.description: The floor with the IMU's I2C master initialized and the IMU powered down.
quantities.forecastRole: Always-on increment.

quantities.description: The floor with the battery-monitor ADC initialized and idle.
quantities.forecastRole: Always-on increment.

quantities.description: The floor with both microphone power switches driven off instead of left at their reset state.
quantities.forecastRole: A difference from the floor means an unused switch input is floating and leaking.

quantities.description: The floor with the red LED lit steadily.
quantities.forecastRole: LED on-current; the forecaster applies each pattern's duty cycle.

prior.note: Placeholder blink average, not a steady on-current.

quantities.description: The floor with the green LED lit steadily.
quantities.forecastRole: LED on-current; the forecaster applies each pattern's duty cycle.

prior.note: Placeholder blink average, not a steady on-current.

quantities.description: The floor with the VHF enable output asserted.
quantities.forecastRole: What the beacon's enable line draws from the A3EM cell; the beacon itself has its own battery.

prior.note: Assumes the enable line draws nothing.

quantities.description: Every peripheral initialized exactly as the deployment firmware does, card powered and mounted, magnet armed.
quantities.forecastRole: Cross-check: should equal the floor plus the always-on increments plus SD_IDLE for the card fitted.

quantities.description: Processor running register-and-cache-bound work continuously at the deployment clock, nothing else on.
quantities.forecastRole: Generic active current, for work not covered by a dedicated event.

prior.source: Web/reference/A3EM Deployment Planner.xlsx Calculations!E28 (MCU active, marked '<- Measure')

quantities.description: Power-off mode waiting on an RTC alarm only.
quantities.forecastRole: Shelf, pre-deployment, and between-phase sleeps without magnetic wake.

quantities.description: Power-off mode with the magnet sensor sampled every 500 ms for a wake.
quantities.forecastRole: Shelf and between-phase sleeps when the magnet can wake the device.

quantities.event: one wake from deep sleep and return
quantities.description: A bare wake from deep sleep on a timer interrupt, doing nothing.
quantities.forecastRole: Charged per wake: DMA completions, alarms, and every other interrupt.

quantities.description: One battery and temperature measurement.
quantities.forecastRole: Charged at every TELEM and validation wake, and every 10 s while awake loops service the temperature trim.

quantities.description: The floor with the card powered and mounted but asleep between transfers, as it is throughout a recording phase.
quantities.forecastRole: Always-on increment during recording phases; specific to the card model.

quantities.description: SD_IDLE plus a 1 Hz wake doing nothing, with a file open.
quantities.forecastRole: Baseline for the SD events.

quantities.event: one session: wake the card, write 4 KiB, sleep it
quantities.description: One card session writing 4 KiB.
quantities.forecastRole: Fit point for session charge = fixed + per-byte x bytes.

prior.source: Web/reference/A3EM Deployment Planner.xlsx derived from Calculations!E23:E26,E31 and SdSpeeds U1
prior.note: 35 mA x 25 ms wake + 75 mA writing at 10 MB/s + 5 ms FAT upkeep at 75 mA.

quantities.forecastRole: Charged per frame the gate examines; frames per buffer follow from the DMA size. Analysis stops at the first loud frame, so this is the most a buffer can cost.

quantities.description: 48 kHz capture plus a 512 KiB card session and a battery reading every second, run while the supply is stepped down until cycles fail.
quantities.forecastRole: The lowest supply the board works at under its heaviest load. A cell is used up when its loaded voltage at the sensed temperature falls to this, so it sets end of life in the forecast and is where a temperature-aware cutoff belongs.
